findings.title: Elevated Model Router Response Latency

evidence.observation: Model router telemetry reports recent_avg_ms of 138732 ms (~138.7 seconds per request)

proposed_action.description: Tune Ollama model keep-alive configurations and investigate local compute constraints or queueing bottlenecks causing 138s average latency

findings.expected_benefit: Substantially reduces system response latency across core automated workflows and prevents downstream timeout failures
